SIM-BUG: Z flag updated unconditionally on all instructions

alu.cpp:96-97 sets Z flag based on ALU output for ALL operations including aluNOP. For aluNOP, aout.value stays 0xFFFF (initialized at line 17), so Z is always cleared.

Hardware gates Z updates: only R-type (aluctl=001) and S-type (aluctl=010) update the Z register. Non-ALU instructions (LIL, LIU, LW, SW, JAL, etc.) preserve the previous Z value.

Fix: only set Z flag when op is aluR or aluS. Skip flag update for aluNOP, aluOFFSET, aluREL.

Trace evidence: test_branch MW 0003 (GHDL=0001, sim=0000). SUB sets Z=1, LIL follows, BZ should still see Z=1 but sim sees Z=0.
